predecessors.name: Sui dynasty
predecessors.text: 'much of the territory in modern eastern Gansu' (the page), as radii round Lanzhou and Tianshui

successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: 'much of the territory in modern eastern Gansu' (the page), as radii round Lanzhou and Tianshui

ledger.x: 617: the capital moves from Jincheng to Tianshui after Xue Rengao captures it; the page places this after Xue Ju's fall 617 claim to the imperial title and gives no month (month 10 is a reading).
618: Qin and Tang fight for the Wei valley.
618: the fighting ends with the Qin's collapse.
618: the Qin is annexed by the Tang.

wars.name: Tang campaign against Xue Ju and Xue Rengao
wars.outcome: Tang victory: Xue Ju died in 618 and Xue Rengao's defeat ended the Qin.

certainty.note: A rebel region of eastern Gansu; the page gives regions, no boundary.
